headline: Genki’s new customizable controller has a big screen and adjustable buttons
summary: Genki launched the Manta, a new customizable controller. It features an unorthodox design with a 2.9-inch LCD screen. The controller also boasts adjustable buttons for personalized gaming.

headline: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
summary: Google Discover will soon offer an AI-powered, customizable content feed. Users can describe desired content to tailor their feed. The AI will remember preferences for future visits, rolling out soon.

headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games is concluding development on its League of Legends fighting game, 2XKO. The decision comes due to insufficient player retention and sustainability. Active development will cease by the end of 2026.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what’s possible in EV design
summary: Genesis unveiled its first full-size, three-row electric SUV, the GV90. It boasts some of the wildest designs and features in the auto market. Unique coach-style doors signal its unconventional approach.

headline: Netflix Reveals New Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Trailer and Images at Anime NYC
summary: Netflix unveiled a new trailer and images for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. The reveal provides a closer look at the series' high-octane action. Fans can anticipate more heartbreak in Night City.

headline: Netflix Confirms Blue Eye Samurai Will End With Third and Final Season
summary: Netflix confirmed that Blue Eye Samurai will conclude with its third season. This will be the show's final season. The announcement marks the end of the acclaimed series.

headline: Netflix Reveals Packed Anime Slate: Full Announcement Rundown, Trailers, and Images
summary: Netflix revealed a massive slate of upcoming anime projects at Anime NYC. Exclusive trailers and images were shown for various series. Highlights included Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and The One Piece.

headline: Double Your PlayStation 5 Storage With This 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for Just $136.39 Shipped
summary: A 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for PS5 is available for $136.39. This upgrade doubles the PlayStation 5's storage capacity. It's considered a near-essential upgrade for PS5 owners.

headline: El Niño warming set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
summary: The Met Office warns El Niño warming will be the strongest in living memory. Scientists call it an 'unprecedented event.' 2027 is projected to be the world's hottest year on record.

headline: Will Harry's return heal deep-rooted rift with William?
summary: Prince William reportedly remains unforgiving towards Prince Harry. The deep-rooted rift between the brothers persists. William's hurt feelings continue to linger, impacting reconciliation.

headline: Meghan could return to acting once back in UK
summary: Meghan Markle might return to acting if she moves back to the UK. Sources close to the Sussexes have not denied reports of an acting offer. Speculation grows around her potential career shift.

headline: Israeli settlers return to Kadim in West Bank two decades after it was evacuated
summary: Israeli settlers have returned to Kadim in the West Bank after two decades. Thirty 'pioneer families' arrived, driven by rising nationalism. Nearby Palestinian residents express fear over the rapid change.
